name: ruber-visual-mograph
description: Ruber Visual - hyper dynamic motion graphic built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render RuberVisual out/ruber-visual-16x9.mp4 --crf=20 && node scripts/master.mjs out/ruber-visual-16x9.mp4 out/ruber-visual-16x9-master.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render RuberVisualVertical out/ruber-visual-9x16.mp4 --crf=20 && node scripts/master.mjs out/ruber-visual-9x16.mp4 out/ruber-visual-9x16-master.mp4
scripts.master: node scripts/master.mjs out/ruber-visual-16x9.mp4 out/ruber-visual-16x9-master.mp4 && node scripts/master.mjs out/ruber-visual-9x16.mp4 out/ruber-visual-9x16-master.mp4
